name: cavemio-waitlist
title: Waitlist
description: A waitlist that is an actual line: you step in at the end with your number over your head, and every friend who joins lets you hop past the person ahead.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The email field is labelled and validated in place; Join is a submit button, so Enter works. A status region says the place in line whenever it changes.
- The line is decoration (aria-hidden). The people and the door are illustrations shipped inside queue-art.ts as WebP data URIs (55KB of images), so the install is complete; the hops, the line closing up and the door are code.
- The street is drawn at 364 × 176 and scaled to the stage; people move with transforms only.
- With reduced motion the numbers change in place and nobody hops or walks.
- Built from Copy button, Input, Number roll, Status button and Text morph, which the CLI installs with it. No animation library.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: onJoin
props.type: (email: string) => Promise<{ position: number; link?: string }>
props.description: – · Add the email; return their place and invite link. Throw an Error to show its message.

props.name: position
props.description: – · Their place after joining, from your server; every drop plays a hop.

props.name: referrals
props.description: 0 · Friends who have joined through their link.

props.name: perFriend
props.description: 50 · Places each friend moves them up, for the copy and the number of hops.

props.name: admitted
props.description: false · Let in: the door opens and they walk through.

props.name: product
props.description: "early access" · What they’re waiting for, in the copy.

features.title: A place you can see
features.description: Your position rolls in a chip over your head in the line.

features.title: Invites that move you
features.description: Each drop in position plays a hop past the person ahead (up to three in a row), and the number rolls down.

features.title: Your server’s numbers
features.description: position, referrals and admitted are props: update them from a poll, a socket or a page load.

features.title: The invite link
features.description: onJoin can return a link, shown with a copy button.

features.title: Email checks
features.description: An obviously wrong address is caught in place; onJoin can throw to say why it was refused.

features.title: Let in
features.description: admitted opens the door and walks you through it.

states.title: line
states.description: A green door at the left of the lit stage, five illustrated people waiting in profile, and a dashed outline at the end with a You? chip; “Join the line”.

states.title: join
states.description: Join → Joining → Joined; the outline fades as you rise into the line, lit, with your number rolling into the chip; the form folds into “You’re on the list”.

states.title: skip
states.description: position drops: you leap (520ms arc) over the person ahead as you swap places, they slide back and fade, the line steps up one place behind a newcomer at the door, and the number rolls down; “Excuse me, coming through”, then “Skipped 1 ahead”.

states.title: link
states.description: The invite link sits in a pill with Copy link; “Each friend who joins moves you up 50 places. 2 friends so far.”

states.title: admitted
states.description: The door swings open (crossfade to the lit doorway) and you walk to it and fade through; “You’re in”.

states.title: refused
states.description: A bad email or a throw from onJoin: the field shakes and shows the reason.
